title: Attractor Domain Theory: A Mathematical Framework for Cardiovascular Attractor Analysis with Wearable Photoplethysmography (PPG) Validation
abstract: arXiv:2606.22039v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The cardiac attractor provides a phase-space representation of cardiovascular dynamics reconstructed from scalar observations under standard delay-embedding conditions. We introduce Attractor Domain Theory (ADT), a theory in which linked mathematical transformations expose distinct properties of reconstructed dynamics: the Geometry Domain is obtained through the delay-reconstruction transformation, while Ergodic and Variational transformations act on that geometry to characterize long-horizon organization and localized finite-time deformation. Thus, ADT specifies a three-representation operator architecture for reconstructed dynamics rather than retrospectively grouping existing nonlinear features; the architecture is proposed as an operational organization, not as a uniqueness or exhaustiveness theorem. translated_title: 吸引子域理论：一种经可穿戴光电容积脉搏波（PPG）验证的心血管吸引子分析数学框架
translated_abstract: 心脏吸引子提供了在标准延迟嵌入条件下由标量观测重构的心血管动力学的相空间表示。我们提出吸引子域理论，该理论通过一组相互关联的数学变换揭示重构动力学的不同性质：几何域通过延迟重构变换获得，而遍历变换和变分变换则作用于该几何，用以刻画长时程组织结构与局部有限时间形变。因此，ADT为重构动力学规定了一种三表示的算子架构，而非对现有非线性特征进行回顾性归类；该架构被提出作为一种操作性组织框架，而非唯一性或穷尽性定理。条件域分解通过显式残差量化特定端点的增量信息，以及一个域轨……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出吸引子域理论（ADT），通过延迟重构、遍历与变分等相互关联的数学变换，为心血管吸引子动力学构建了一种包含几何域、遍历域和变分域的三表示算子架构，并以可穿戴光电容积脉搏波（PPG）数据进行了验证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Attractor Domain Theory (ADT), a mathematical framework that organizes reconstructed cardiovascular attractor dynamics into geometry, ergodic, and variational domains through linked mathematical transformations, validated using wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) data.
